description: Searches the library by meaning. Returns ranked passage snippets (the ref and its first ~180 characters) with links. Snippets are short excerpts, not full passages. Optional hebrew_terms rank passages that contain those Hebrew words higher.

hebrew_terms.description: The key Jewish terms of the query in Hebrew script, e.g. ["בריאת העולם", "תכלית"] for "why did God create the world". Passages that contain these words rank higher.

ref_prefix.description: Optional: restrict results to a ref prefix — a section ('Genesis 1') or a book title ('Tanya', 'Mishnah Berurah').

name: semantic_search
title: Search the Bereishes library
